from solution import add_consecutive_nums


def test_issue_example_from_description():
    """Add consecutive numbers as in [1,1,3,4,4,5,6,7]==[2,4,7,8,9,11,13]."""
    expected = [2, 4, 7, 8, 9, 11, 13]  # 1+1=2, 1+3=4, 3+4=7, 4+4=8, 4+5=9, 5+6=11, 6+7=13
    assert add_consecutive_nums([1, 1, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 7]) == expected


def test_issue_empty_list_returns_empty():
    """Empty list has no consecutive numbers so returns empty list."""
    expected = []  # no pairs so no sums: 0 items -> 0 sums
    assert add_consecutive_nums([]) == expected


def test_issue_single_element_returns_empty():
    """Single element has no consecutive pair so returns empty list."""
    expected = []  # single item [7] has no a+b to compute
    assert add_consecutive_nums([7]) == expected


def test_issue_two_elements_single_sum():
    """Two consecutive numbers are added into one sum."""
    expected = [5]  # 2+3=5
    assert add_consecutive_nums([2, 3]) == expected


def test_issue_three_elements_two_sums():
    """Three numbers produce two sums of consecutive pairs."""
    expected = [3, 5]  # 1+2=3, 2+3=5
    assert add_consecutive_nums([1, 2, 3]) == expected


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Add consecutive numbers works the same for negative numbers."""
    expected = [-8, -1]  # -5+-3=-8, -3+2=-1
    assert add_consecutive_nums([-5, -3, 2]) == expected


def test_issue_zeros():
    """Add consecutive numbers of zeros gives zeros."""
    expected = [0, 0]  # 0+0=0, 0+0=0
    assert add_consecutive_nums([0, 0, 0]) == expected


def test_issue_descending_values():
    """Add consecutive numbers works for descending order adjacently."""
    expected = [9, 7]  # 5+4=9, 4+3=7
    assert add_consecutive_nums([5, 4, 3]) == expected


def test_issue_gapped_values_still_added():
    """Add consecutive numbers means adjacent items even with gaps."""
    expected = [10, 10]  # 10+0=10, 0+10=10
    assert add_consecutive_nums([10, 0, 10]) == expected


def test_issue_repeated_values():
    """Add consecutive numbers of repeated values sums each pair."""
    expected = [8, 8, 8]  # 4+4=8, 4+4=8, 4+4=8
    assert add_consecutive_nums([4, 4, 4, 4]) == expected


def test_issue_float_values():
    """Add consecutive numbers works for floats as adjacent sums."""
    expected = [4.0, 5.5]  # 1.5+2.5=4.0, 2.5+3.0=5.5
    assert add_consecutive_nums([1.5, 2.5, 3.0]) == expected


def test_contract_returns_list():
    """Function returns a list as shown in the example."""
    result = add_consecutive_nums([8, 9])  # input [8, 9] with 8+9=17 expected [17]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_contract_output_length_is_input_minus_one():
    """Pairwise sums give output length one less than input length."""
    result = add_consecutive_nums([1, 2, 3, 4])  # 1+2=3, 2+3=5, 3+4=7 expected [3, 5, 7]
    assert len(result) == 3  # 4-1=3
